inference: Exploratory paired comparisons on an already inspected test set. Two-sided exact McNemar coverage test and exact paired-swap mean-set-size test. Holm adjustment across all top-k/arm/partition comparisons and both outcomes together. Pointwise 95% question-bootstrap intervals condition on fitted snapshots; they exclude training/calibration variability. No setting selected from test results.
exponent_definition: R_gamma(x,y)=R(x,y)**gamma, applied to both candidate labels and calibration true-label scores; thresholds re-estimated in the same cells. This is not a memory kernel exponent or probability renormalization.
